title: Result
description: The outcome page as a part: the mark, the verdict and the next action, centered. Success, failure, and the space between.
usage: For the end of a flow — paid, sent, deleted, failed. One verdict per page, said in the title; the words under it carry the detail (the reference number, the reason), and the buttons carry the way out. Empty State is for "nothing here yet"; Result is for "this just happened".
a11y: The mark is decoration — the verdict lives in the heading text, never in the icon alone. After a submitted flow, move focus to the heading so the outcome is the first thing announced.
